_readme: Monastic seats (mathas) to which Saraswat families owe allegiance. Living pontiffs are deliberately not listed, since the archive is not maintained fast enough to keep them accurate.

items.name: Shri Kashi Math Samsthan
items.seat: Varanasi, with branches at Walkeshwar (Mumbai), Haldipur, Basrur and Cochin
items.note: Dvaita/Vaishnava lineage established under Shrimad Yadavendra Tirtha. Followers are often called Kashi Math Samsthan GSBs.

items.name: Shri Gokarn Partagali Jeevottam Math
items.note: Founded by Shrimad Narayana Teertha. A principal Vaishnava seat of the Goud Saraswat community.

items.name: Shri Saunsthan Gaudapadacharya, Kavale
items.note: Traditionally regarded as the oldest matha of the Saraswats, tracing to Shri Gaudapadacharya. Smarta / Advaita.

items.name: Shri Chitrapur Math
items.note: Guru parampara begins with Shrimat Parijnanashram Swami I. The spiritual home of the Chitrapur Saraswats (Bhanaps).

items.name: Shri Kaivalya Math (Shri Sansthan Kaivalyapura)
items.note: Recorded by some Smarta Saraswat families of Goa and coastal Maharashtra.

items.name: Shri Sharada Peetham, Shringeri
items.note: Some Smarta Saraswat families additionally record allegiance to Shringeri.

items.name: Shri Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham
items.note: Recorded by a minority of Smarta families, chiefly those settled in the south.

items.name: Not recorded / unaffiliated
items.note: Use when the family's matha is unknown, or when a family does not observe a matha affiliation.
